payment of 0.30 Bt./shareApril 9, 2026: The 2026 AGM approved an additional dividend payment of 0.30 Bt./share,  based on the 
company ’s operating results for 2025, totaling approximately 1,197 MB. The additional dividend payment has paid 
on 28 April 2026. Thus, the Company has paid the dividend for the year 2025 at the rate of 0.60 Bt./ share or

products (Nakhon Pathom/Samut Sakhon) from the Thailand Greenhouse Gas Management Organization (Public 
Organization). This reflects its commitment to sustainable business operations coupled with effective environmental 
management.
